stores.note: auralee.jp has its own online store that ships to the US by DHL. With the country set to United States it shows USD prices with duties and taxes included, and those are the prices below. The $500 cap rules out nearly all of the brand's textured pieces: its tweed, moleskin, corduroy, flannel and denim items are all $533–$3,800. Men's items that fit the profile and cost $500 or less are limited to sweats, tees and accessories. Excluded: the Wool Silk Soft Rib Henley ($434.50, bold rib, in stock) because the site calls it a slim fit; the Super High Gauge Sweat P/O ($440) because it is smooth and nearly sold out; and the Luster Plaiting tees ($258.50–$286) because they are smooth, not textured. Stock was checked 2026-09-25 using the page's item_stock data.
stores.vibe: Quiet Tokyo minimalism built entirely around developing its own fabrics: muted, heathered colors in very fine yarns, where the cloth itself is the design.
